given: An unsigned file claims a reserved namespace.
expected: Refuse the identity; format validity does not grant trust.

given: A legacy impostor occupies the genuine id and version.
expected: Quarantine the impostor and admit the exact signed release.

given: The catalog is offline and a higher unsigned version exists.
expected: Resolve only exact remembered trusted bytes; do not hide the genuine update.

given: A local/ file crosses between two household data roots.
expected: The receiving host says shared; the exporting host recognizes its own receipt.

given: An unsigned publisher claims an existing update identity.
expected: Expose the unverified identity and require explicit update confirmation.

given: Imported names or nested keys include controls or bidi formatting.
expected: Refuse narrow forbidden characters; accept plain RTL and joiners.

given: A ZIP64 locator overrides a bounded legacy end record.
expected: Refuse before constructing ZipFile or allocating its directory.

given: Images or MP3s contain hidden metadata.
expected: Refuse metadata, including JPEG metadata after scans; allow only plain TSSE encoder tags.

given: An import declares unneeded capabilities, exhausts spool quota or exceeds worker memory.
expected: Warn for extra capabilities, charge spool plus decoder bytes, cancel and clean up bounded workers.
